assessment_answer_payload_check.name: assessment_answer_payload_check
assessment_answer_payload_check.value: ("assessment_answers"."status" = 'pending' AND "assessment_answers"."answer" IS NULL) OR ("assessment_answers"."status" = 'answered' AND "assessment_answers"."answer" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("assessment_answers"."answer") = 'object')

assessment_instrument_publication_check.name: assessment_instrument_publication_check
assessment_instrument_publication_check.value: "assessment_instrument_versions"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("assessment_instrument_versions"."approval_status" = 'approved' AND "assessment_instrument_versions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_instrument_versions"."approval_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_instrument_versions"."license_status" IN ('authorized', 'not_applicable'))

assessment_result_safety_unassessed_chec.name: assessment_result_safety_unassessed_check
assessment_result_safety_unassessed_chec.value: jsonb_typeof("assessment_results"."safety_state") = 'object' AND "assessment_results"."safety_state"->>'status' IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_results"."safety_state"->>'status' = 'not_available' AND "assessment_results"."safety_state"->>'reason' IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_results"."safety_state"->>'reason' = 'not_assessed'

preliminary_assessment_timestamps_check.name: preliminary_assessment_timestamps_check
preliminary_assessment_timestamps_check.value: "preliminary_assessments"."created_at" <= "preliminary_assessments"."started_at" AND "preliminary_assessments"."started_at" <= "preliminary_assessments"."updated_at" AND ("preliminary_assessments"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "preliminary_assessments"."started_at" <= "preliminary_assessments"."completed_at") AND ("preliminary_assessments"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL OR "preliminary_assessments"."started_at" <= "preliminary_assessments"."withdrawn_at")

monitoring_sessions_closed_state_ck.name: monitoring_sessions_closed_state_ck
monitoring_sessions_closed_state_ck.value: ("monitoring_sessions"."status" = 'in_progress' and "monitoring_sessions"."closed_at" is null) or ("monitoring_sessions"."status" in ('completed', 'abandoned') and "monitoring_sessions"."closed_at" is not null)
